audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows read 'Skill' in both layers while the content whys and the packet chart both describe a lane Heimerdinger owns until 6 and again at first item.
audit.why: Packet chart is Heimerdinger for rows 0-3, Urgot at level 6, Heimerdinger at first item, Urgot at 2+ items — and the content whys already say exactly that. The mirror records the same fix on its side (chart re-aligned to packet as one atomic group). Both layers proposed together with the phase whys that would otherwise contradict them.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Urgot / Heimerdinger / Urgot.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns and no ranges, so 'engage when the grenade is down' has no length attached to it.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at 970 range, Hextech Micro-Rockets 11/10/9/8/7s at 1325, the turret goes down on a 1s cooldown for 20 mana, UPGRADE!!! is 100/85/70s. Yours: Disdain 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, Purge 12/9/6/3/0s inside 490, Corrosive Charge 10s at 800, Fear Beyond Death 100/85/70s at 2500. The range gap — his 1325 against your 490 — is the whole reason rows 0-3 are his.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and the level whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two invented mechanics and one invented ability name. The page says Fear Beyond Death 'flips you past the turret wall' and 'ignores his zoning', and breakdown.cooldowns names a 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' that does not exist.
audit.why: Fear Beyond Death impales the first enemy CHAMPION hit — turrets and minions are not champions, so the ult simply is not blocked by his nest; that is the real, checkable fact, and it does not move Urgot anywhere. Disdain 'tramples non-champion enemies', so his turrets do not stop the charge either. His grenade is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, and only a direct hit stuns: the surrounding units are merely slowed.
audit.corrected: spikes[1], spikes[3], mid, late, wants.you[0] and report[5].t rewritten around the impale-first-champion and trample rules; the fake grenade name replaced.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's own defect says the page never names any of his abilities; it referred only to 'CH-2 Grenade (Stun)' and 'turrets'.
audit.why: A player tracking a cooldown needs the real name to recognise it: H-28 G Evolution Turret, Hextech Micro-Rockets, CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, UPGRADE!!!, Hextech Affinity.
audit.corrected: Real names now appear in the cooldown block and the level whys.

edits.before: Full legs rotation online — this is your lane now. Walk Heimerdinger down with W whenever CH-2 Grenade (Stun) is on cooldown.
edits.after: Full legs rotation online, but a fresh H-28 G turret costs him 20 mana on a 1s cooldown — you cannot out-clear the field. Give ground.

edits.before: Q and W ranks make the grind trades brutal. Force Heimerdinger to choose between CS and health; he can't have both into your spray.
edits.after: Q and W ranks make the grind brutal, but Micro-Rockets reach 1325 and the grenade lands at 970 — he never has to stand in your 490.

edits.before: Black Cleaver stacks instantly with W — your shred turns even tanky answers soft. Shove and force Heimerdinger to trade into the spike.
edits.after: Black Cleaver stacks fast with W, yet an UPGRADE!!! turret re-zones the wave faster than you clear it — pick a fight, do not grind one.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade (Stun): matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Heimerdinger CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Lobs a grenade that slows, and stuns at the center. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade: flat 11s at 970. Only a direct hit stuns; everything around it is merely slowed, so his one hard answer is gone for 11 seconds. - Hextech Micro-Rockets: 11/10/9/8/7s of poke from 1325. - H-28 G turret: 1s cooldown, 20 mana.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Only a direct hit stuns; the splash just slows. Flat 11s — commit then.

edits.before: Track Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade (Stun): His self-peel stun. Dodge it. When it is down — W-shred him.
edits.after: Disdain tramples non-champions, so turrets never stop your charge — only he does, and that is an 11s grenade.

edits.before: This is your escape hatch — R Fear Beyond Death lets you flip past the turret wall and execute Heimerdinger himself; he has no dash, so a landed Q slow into R is a death sentence for him even behind his turrets.
edits.after: This is your escape hatch — Fear Beyond Death impales the first enemy champion hit, so turrets and minions never block its path: land Corrosive Charge's slow at 800, fire from as far as 2500, and he has no dash to leave with.

edits.before: You reclaim it as a tank-shredder: Purge and Cleaver let you dive through the turret field, R ignores his zoning to lock him down, and in fights his lack of mobility means one flip ends him.
edits.after: You reclaim it as a tank-shredder: Purge and Cleaver carry you through the turret field, Disdain tramples the turrets instead of stopping on them, and with no dash at all one flip ends him.

edits.before: Wait for Level 6, then R over the turret wall to execute him
edits.after: Wait for level 6 — his turrets never block the ult's path

edits.before: Level 6 is the turning point: R Fear Beyond Death flips you past the turret wall directly onto Heimerdinger, and since he has no dash a Q slow into R means a guaranteed execute. Between ults, though, he re-establishes the turret zone, so pick your all-in around R being up rather than trying to grind through his DPS field.
edits.after: Level 6 is the turning point: Fear Beyond Death impales the first enemy champion hit, so the turret wall does not block it, and with no dash of his own a Corrosive Charge slow into your ult is a commit he cannot answer. Between ults he rebuilds the zone on a 1s turret cooldown, so fight around R being up rather than grinding his DPS field.

edits.before: At first item his Liandry's poke and upgraded ult turret let him zone and chunk you again before you engage. But with 2+ items you take over — as a tank-shredder your Purge and Cleaver carry you through the turrets, R still ignores his zoning to lock him, and his total lack of mobility means a single flip ends the immobile turret-mage in any fight.
edits.after: At first item his Liandry's poke and an UPGRADE!!! turret zone and chunk you again before you ever engage. But with 2+ items you take over — Purge and Cleaver carry you through the turret field, Disdain tramples the turrets outright rather than stopping on them, and with no mobility at all a single flip ends the turret-mage in any fight.

notes: Two invented mechanics removed: Fear Beyond Death does not move Urgot 'past the turret wall', and no text supports it 'ignoring zoning'. What the kit does support and now appears instead: the ult impales the first enemy CHAMPION (so non-champion units never block it) and Disdain tramples non-champion enemies (so turrets do not stop the charge). Invented ability name 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' replaced with CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade. Not asserted: spell shield, cleanse, QSS or tenacity behaviour against Fear Beyond Death — none of it is in the kit text.
